query:
SELECT id, title, slug, createdAt, date,
  LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(blocks, '$')) as block_count,
  CASE WHEN coverImageUrl IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as has_image
FROM news 
WHERE status = 'published'
ORDER BY createdAt ASC
LIMIT 40;
